verdict.rationale: Kick documents backfilling historical data by uploading PDF bank statements or CSVs through its Universal Importer. 'Migration support' is listed only on the custom Advanced plan, and an accountant testimonial mentions moving off QBO. This re-imports raw bank activity rather than migrating existing books, so preserving transaction-level accounting detail is not shown. Missing for 10: a documented import from QuickBooks/Xero or other accounting systems, migration of the chart of accounts, journal entries, categorizations and attachments, any description of what Advanced-plan migration support includes, and independent or hands-on evidence of a lossless migration.
